purpose: Parameter profile for pipeline testing and sensitivity analysis; not a clinical decision model.

sources.description: Published prostate radiotherapy fractionation literature commonly evaluates low alpha/beta behavior; this profile uses a broad exploratory range rather than a validated patient-specific estimate.
sources.reference: Brenner DJ, Hall EJ. Fractionation and prostate cancer radiotherapy. Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys. 1999; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/10509876/

sources.description: QUANTEC dose-volume guidance informs the use of EUD/NTCP-style OAR analysis, but its population-level constraints are not a patient-specific NTCP model.
sources.reference: Marks LB et al. Use of normal tissue complication probability models in the clinic. Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys. 2010; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/20171514/

sources.description: A phenomenological proton RBE formulation is represented only as a sensitivity assumption here; the value is not patient-specific or clinically validated by this project.
sources.reference: McNamara AL et al. A phenomenological model of proton relative biological effectiveness. Phys Med Biol. 2015; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/26232347/

limitations: No parameter in this profile is calibrated to the synthetic XCAT cases.
No parameter in this profile establishes cancer kill, tumor control, OAR sparing, or patient-specific RBE.
The initial clonogen count is a modeling variable, not a patient measurement.
The LKB parameters are placeholders for software and sensitivity testing, not approved QUANTEC thresholds.
The dose field is exploratory OpenTOPAS output normalized to a prescription peak and is not a commissioned clinical plan.
